resources.string: A more reliable connection, by design
Madar selects verified routes based on real network health. This preview connects only to an explicitly provisioned staging subscription.
The VPN engine and real-world carrier tests are not complete. No background VPN session is active.
Traffic is routed only while the verified VPN session is active.
A route will only appear as available after its own authentication and tunneled traffic checks have passed.
We separately verify DNS, IP reachability, TLS, WebSocket, proxy handshake and traffic. We do not treat a successful ping as proof of VPN access.
Carrier performance depends on your network and region. Universal connectivity cannot be guaranteed.
Purchases, usage, renewal and support will become available after secure account migration and payment acceptance tests.
Your existing subscription remains managed by the current bot.
A VPN is never reported as connected without a verified tunnel and successful traffic test.
Madar will classify the failed layer and try an eligible alternative. Connection errors must not silently consume your plan.
Only minimal account, subscription and anonymized diagnostic data required to provide and secure the service. Never share passwords or private keys in support chats.
